twoFactor.cardSubtitle: A second step is required on every new browser — an authenticator app or a code we email you.
twoFactor.offHint: Required — protects your funds even if your password leaks.
twoFactor.lowCodes: You're running low on backup codes — generate a new set.
twoFactor.toastDisabled: Authenticator app turned off — you'll get email codes at sign-in instead.
twoFactor.setupBody: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or any TOTP app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.setupFailed: Couldn't start the 2FA setup. Please try again.
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Enter a fresh code from your app.
twoFactor.enabledBody: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, each code lets you sign in once. They won't be shown again.
twoFactor.disableBody: Your account will only be protected by your password. Confirm it's you to continue.
twoFactor.regenerateBody: Your current backup codes stop working the moment new ones are created. Confirm it's you to continue.
twoFactor.newCodesBody: Here are your new backup codes. Store them safely — the old ones no longer work.
twoFactor.reauthFailed: We couldn't confirm your identity. Please try again.
twoFactor.disableBodyStepUp: Your authenticator app will be removed. A second step stays mandatory, so we'll email you a code when you sign in on a new browser instead. We'll ask you to verify it's you first.
twoFactor.regenerateBodyStepUp: Your current backup codes stop working the moment new ones are created. We'll ask you to verify it's you first.
twoFactor.enrollSubtitle: Two-step verification is required on Dynopay. Choose how you'd like to confirm it's you when signing in on a new browser.
twoFactor.hardWallSubtitle: Your 14-day grace period has ended. Set up an authenticator app or email codes to keep using Dynopay — it takes about a minute.
twoFactor.bannerLastDay: Two-step verification becomes required tomorrow. Set it up now to avoid interruptions.
twoFactor.bannerDays: Two-step verification becomes required on {{date}} ({{days}} days left). Protect your account now.
twoFactor.interstitialTitle: Protect your account in a minute
twoFactor.interstitialSubtitle: Two-step verification becomes required for everyone on {{date}}. Set it up now and you won't be asked again — only new browsers get a code check.
twoFactor.emailSendFailed: Couldn't send the code. Please try again.
twoFactor.emailInvalidCode: That code didn't match. Please try again.
twoFactor.emailEnrollBody: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it below to confirm you can receive sign-in codes there.
twoFactor.emailEnrollSending: Sending a 6-digit code to your account email…
twoFactor.methodAppBody: Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy… Works offline and is the most secure option.
twoFactor.methodEmailBody: We email you a 6-digit code when you sign in on a new browser. No app needed.
